audience.text: Python developers who need to parse, inspect, and extract content from OneNote (.one) files programmatically, especially for reporting, migration, or integration workflows.

capabilities.text: Load .one files from a file path or binary stream using Document, with no external OneNote installation required.
capabilities.title: Parse OneNote files from path or stream

capabilities.text: Traverse the document tree using CompositeNode.GetChildNodes() for type-based search or DocumentVisitor for full depth-first traversal.
capabilities.title: Traverse document tree

capabilities.text: Read TextRun and TextStyle properties—including bold, italic, underline, hyperlinks, font, color, and superscript/subscript—via RichText.TextRuns.
capabilities.title: Extract rich text with formatting

capabilities.text: Export pages to PDF using Document.Save() with SaveFormat.Pdf and PdfSaveOptions for JPEG quality and image compression control.
capabilities.title: Export pages to PDF

capabilities.text: Extract embedded images and attached files as bytes, with FileName and metadata, for saving to disk or further processing.
capabilities.title: Extract images and attachments

capabilities.text: Inspect tables via Table/TableRow/TableCell, tags via NoteTag, and numbered lists via NumberList to extract structured content.
capabilities.title: Inspect tables, tags, and lists

capabilities.text: Read page metadata such as Title, Author, CreationTime, LastModifiedTime, and Level, plus revision history via PageHistory.
capabilities.title: Access page metadata and history

capabilities.text: Raise specific exceptions like FileCorruptedException, IncorrectDocumentStructureException, and UnsupportedFileFormatException for error handling.
capabilities.title: Handle exceptions for malformed or unsupported files

limitations.text: Writing back to .one files is not implemented; this library only reads OneNote files.
Password-protected documents are not supported; supplying a password raises IncorrectPasswordException.
SaveFormat currently declares only Pdf; Document.Save() raises UnsupportedSaveFormatException for other formats.
License.SetLicense() and Metered.SetMeteredKey() are no-ops in this edition and do not affect runtime behavior.
DetectLayoutChanges() is a compatibility stub and performs no layout computation.
LoadOptions.DocumentPassword is not supported; encrypted OneNote files cannot be loaded.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic access to OneNote document structure—including pages, rich text, images, tables, attachments, tags, and numbered lists—without requiring Microsoft OneNote to be installed.
Supports exporting OneNote pages to PDF with configurable JPEG quality and image compression, using optional dependencies like reportlab.
Provides a tree-based DOM traversal API via CompositeNode.GetChildNodes() and DocumentVisitor for inspecting or counting document nodes.
Allows extraction of embedded images and attached files as raw bytes, with filenames and metadata, for archival or further processing.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Note FOSS for Python is a free, open-source Python library for reading Microsoft OneNote (.one) files and exporting pages to PDF, with no dependency on Microsoft OneNote or COM automation.

uncertainties: The exact behavior of PageHistory.Add() and related methods in multi-user or versioned scenarios is not documented beyond API signatures.
Whether PageHistory supports adding pages from different Document instances is unclear from the public symbols.
The scope of 'compatibility stub' for DetectLayoutChanges() and its impact on layout-sensitive operations is not specified.
The behavior of TextStyle.DefaultMsOneNote*Style() methods in non-Windows environments is not described.
Whether Image.Replace() preserves tags and hyperlinks is not explicitly stated.
The interaction between ParagraphStyle and RichText.Append/Insert is not detailed in the public symbols.
The exact format of NumberList.GetNumberedListHeader() output for custom formats is not shown.
Whether DocumentVisitor supports early termination or cancellation is not evident from the public API.

workflows.name: Load and inspect a OneNote file
workflows.text: Load a .one file using Document, then access its pages, rich text, and metadata like DisplayName, CreationTime, and Author.

workflows.name: Export to PDF
workflows.text: Call Document.Save() with SaveFormat.Pdf or PdfSaveOptions to generate a PDF output file.

workflows.name: Extract embedded images
workflows.text: Iterate over Image nodes via GetChildNodes(Image), then write Image.Bytes to disk using the FileName or a generated name.

workflows.name: Traverse tables and extract cell content
workflows.text: Iterate over Table, TableRow, and TableCell nodes, then join RichText.Text from each cell to reconstruct tabular data.

workflows.name: Inspect OneNote tags
workflows.text: Access NoteTag instances attached to RichText, Image, or Table nodes to read Label, Status, and Icon.

workflows.name: Count document nodes
workflows.text: Subclass DocumentVisitor and override VisitPageStart, VisitRichTextStart, and VisitImageStart to count pages, rich text, and images.
